item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A surge of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China during the day tomorrow. There will be one or two rain patches and temperatures will fall slightly over the region. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be mainly fine over Guangdong in the following couple of days. With a relatively humid easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong, it will be cloudier with a few rain patches over the region during the weekend and early next week.

Date/Month: 06/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, becoming north force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Cloudy periods and one or two rain patches with relatively low visibility in some areas in the morning. Becoming fine and dry later.
Temp range: 20 - 24 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
